Jev remained disabled without a key; a prior controlled Jev fixture returned a valid off_target judgment. Source-use terms remain unreviewed, GDELT was HTTP 429 in the fresh local run, and social/Finnhub credentials were disabled.
intended_use: Private, single-user research interface for investigating sourced observations and Jev judgments; not an authoritative point-in-time archive or investment signal service.
delivery: Local Docker Compose or local Node process. The public source/build does not provide a hosted data service.

sources.name: Google News RSS
sources.identity: Feed GUID when supplied, otherwise canonical article URL, namespaced by company and collector; company matching is deterministic.
sources.time: Valid RSS pubDate is publisher-declared time; absent or invalid dates remain null. Provider retrieval and local ingestion times are stored separately.
sources.retention: Normalized title, snippet, URL, publisher, identity, time fields, adapter version, and a SHA-256 digest of parsed normalized items are stored. Raw XML is not retained; Jev replay uses normalized local observations, not raw parser input.
sources.rights: Provider terms, permitted display, model access, retention, and redistribution rights have not been reviewed.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance RSS and chart endpoint
sources.identity: Configured symbol is the instrument key; article identity is feed GUID or canonical URL within the RSS collector.
sources.units: Price is a decimal number in the provider-returned currency; changePct is percentage change from provider previous close. No FX conversion is applied.
sources.time: Quote observation time is regularMarketTime when supplied and otherwise unknown. Local retrieval time and per-symbol last-attempt time are separate. Price-series source timestamps are retained, then bucketed using last-observation carry-forward for chart display.
sources.retention: Current quote snapshots and their retrieval state are in memory. Price points are stored in SQLite using source timestamps. Price-series responses disclose network, one-minute memory cache, or local-store delivery and sourceLatestAt. Raw responses are not retained.
sources.rights: Provider terms, permitted display, model access, retention, and redistribution rights have not been reviewed.

sources.name: GDELT DOC 2.0
sources.identity: Article URL and domain, namespaced by company and collector; company match is checked before storage.
sources.time: GDELT seendate is provider-observed time, never publisher publication time. Missing or invalid seendate remains unknown; retrieval and ingestion clocks are separate.
sources.retention: Normalized item fields and a SHA-256 digest of parsed normalized items are stored; raw responses are not retained. Jev replay uses normalized local observations.
sources.rights: Provider terms, permitted display, model access, retention, and redistribution rights have not been reviewed.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR submissions and filing documents
sources.identity: CIK, accession number, form type, and filing items.
sources.time: Filing date and EDGAR acceptanceDateTime are separate. Acceptance is used as the source-declared event timestamp; missing timestamps stay unknown.
sources.retention: Normalized filing metadata and bounded extracted text are stored; acquisition receipts keep adapter versions and a digest of normalized parsed items, not raw SEC bytes. The source model receives the normalized excerpt.
sources.rights: Official public endpoints are used, but the display and retention policy for this project has not been reviewed. A tested packaged SEC connector contract available on the host says ui_display=false, so that connector is not substituted into this display product.

sources.name: Finnhub company news, earnings, and calendar
sources.identity: Provider symbol, article URL, and earnings period when supplied.
sources.time: News datetime and earnings dates use provider fields; absent event times remain unknown. Local retrieval and ingestion are separate.
sources.retention: Optional source enabled only with the operator's FINNHUB_API_KEY; normalized items, response digests of parsed items, and bounded delivery receipts only. No raw response retention.
sources.rights: Operator must supply credentials and follow provider terms; permitted model access, display, and project retention have not been reviewed.

sources.name: X API recent search
sources.identity: Provider post ID and configured ticker/company match.
sources.time: Provider-created time when supplied; absent time stays unknown. Retrieval and ingestion are separate.
sources.retention: Optional source enabled only with the operator's X_BEARER_TOKEN; normalized items and parsed-item digests only. No raw response retention.
sources.rights: Operator must supply credentials and follow provider terms; permitted model access, display, and project retention have not been reviewed.

sources.name: Reddit search
sources.identity: Provider post ID and configured company match.
sources.time: Provider-created time when supplied; absent time stays unknown. Retrieval and ingestion are separate.
sources.retention: Optional source enabled only with the operator's Reddit app credentials; normalized items and parsed-item digests only. No raw response retention.
sources.rights: Operator must supply credentials and follow provider terms; permitted model access, display, and project retention have not been reviewed.

known_gaps: Raw upstream bodies are not retained. Delivery digests cover normalized parsed items and cannot prove parser correctness or replay raw bytes; Jev replay uses normalized observation fields.

Delivery state and newest collected-item event time are separate. An old source timestamp can coexist with a current successful delivery; source age is shown, but no universal content-staleness TTL is claimed because quiet periods and provider query semantics differ.

Yahoo quote retrieval time and source regularMarketTime are separate. A failed per-symbol refresh marks the retained quote as cached and exposes its original retrieval age. Market-closure and holiday correctness is not established by the app's weekday/session display.

Price-series display buckets use last-observation carry-forward; those bucket timestamps are derived display coordinates, not new source price observations. The API retains sourceLatestAt and the resampling policy.

Fresh local browser verification at 2026-09-27 14:13 EEST showed GDELT rate-limited with HTTP 429; Google News RSS, Yahoo Finance RSS, SEC EDGAR, and Yahoo quotes had successful current delivery. GDELT coverage is therefore a current limitation, not evidence of zero GDELT activity.

No Jev credential was supplied during fresh-start and Compose verification, so current real observations stayed pending. A separate bounded controlled Jev fixture previously returned a valid off_target judgment; the fresh live production run did not exercise scoring of a real headline.
Optional X, Reddit, and Finnhub sources were disabled in final verification by explicit empty credentials. Their live coverage and rights are not verified.
Provider terms, permitted model access, display, retention, and redistribution have not been reviewed. Public availability is not treated as a license to republish, and the UI is private and local.

Source retries happen on the next scheduled poll (quote and Jev clients also have bounded request retries); source collectors do not perform an immediate generic retry loop. Provider coverage and pagination completeness are not proven exhaustive.
